title: Barley and Candied Winter Melon Drink
ldName: Barley and Candied Winter Melon Drink
ldKeywords: Chinese barley and winter melon drink tong sui
How to cook Chinese barley tong sui
ldIngredientsRaw: 100 gram barley (Indonesian: jali), washed and drained a couple of times
ldInstructionsRaw: Place all ingredients in a pot and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 1/2 hour until barley is soft.
Taste if it is sweet enough, usually it is, but you can add more sugar if you prefer a sweeter drink.
Turn off heat. Can be served hot, at room temperature, or chilled.
htmlIngredientLines: 100 gram barley (Indonesian: jali), washed and drained a couple of times
